competencyModels.name: Grade 6 Numeracy
competencyModels.description: Core numeracy competencies expected of a Grade 6 learner, covering number sense, fractions, and basic algebraic reasoning.

competencies.name: Whole Number Operations
competencies.description: Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide multi-digit whole numbers accurately.

competencies.name: Fraction Reasoning
competencies.description: Ability to compare, order, and perform operations with fractions.

competencies.name: Pre-Algebraic Reasoning
competencies.description: Ability to recognize patterns and represent simple unknowns in equations.

states.label: Developing
states.description: Solves one-step equations with a single unknown.

states.label: Proficient
states.description: Solves two-step equations and generalizes patterns.

competencies.name: Measurement & Data
competencies.description: Ability to measure quantities accurately and interpret simple data displays.

states.label: Length & Mass
states.description: Measures length and mass using standard units.

states.label: Data Display
states.description: Reads and interprets bar graphs and tables.

states.label: Unit Conversion
states.description: Converts between related units of measure.

competencies.name: Quantitative Reasoning Ability
competencies.description: Overall latent ability to reason quantitatively across numeracy tasks, reported on a continuous scale.

competencyModels.name: Middle School Scientific Inquiry
competencyModels.description: Competencies related to scientific inquiry practices expected of middle school students.

competencies.name: Hypothesis Formation
competencies.description: Ability to formulate testable hypotheses based on observations.

competencies.name: Experimental Design
competencies.description: Ability to design a fair test that isolates a single variable.

states.label: Developing
states.description: Controls one variable at a time with guidance.

competencies.name: Data Interpretation
competencies.description: Ability to interpret experimental data and draw evidence-based conclusions.

competencies.name: Scientific Communication
competencies.description: Ability to communicate scientific findings clearly using appropriate terminology and evidence.

states.label: Written Report
states.description: Communicates findings in written lab reports.

states.label: Oral Presentation
states.description: Communicates findings orally with visual aids.

states.label: Peer Critique
states.description: Gives and responds to constructive scientific critique.

competencies.name: Model-Based Reasoning
competencies.description: Ability to use and revise scientific models to explain phenomena.
